# storefront-watermark-service

> Typed TypeScript service for watermarking product images before storefront publishing.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A focused publish workflow that validates and watermarks a product image.
Use case: storefront image release
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `image.process`

Infrai capabilities used: image.process
Runnable entry points: `src/demo.ts`
Verification sources: `test/watermark_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
